input: raw counts with training-only channel mean/std
target: training-only masked target mean/std; invert before scoring
architecture: 176->32 k3 d1 ReLU ->32 k3 d2 ReLU ->32 k3 d4 ReLU ->7 linear
loss: mean squared standardized target error on supplied training masks after burnin
checkpoint: last epoch, fixed in advance; no evaluation-based early stopping
pilot: seed0 foldA one epoch timing only, no development prediction or score
